Why Search Isn't Enough for Team Docs — What We Learned Building a Knowledge Graph Layer
item.content:encoded:
<p>Every team doc tool promises "search everything." Ours did too — and it still didn't answer the question new hires actually ask: not "where is this doc," but "why does this decision look the way it does, and what else does it touch?"</p>
<p>We spent the last few months trying to solve that by treating team docs less like a filing cabinet and more like a graph. Here's what we tried, what broke, and what we'd do differently.</p>
